title: About NovoTech Machine Tools — Mississauga, Ontario, Canada
meta_description: NovoTech Machine Tools imports and supports metal fabrication machinery in Canada: Dener, GMS, ISITAN, Bekamak, Gecam, EUROSTAMP, CSM and more, from Mississauga, ON, Canada.
intro: NovoTech Machine Tools is a Canadian importer of metal fabrication machinery, based in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. For more than 20 years we have worked with manufacturers we trust to bring Canadian shops machines that are built well, priced right and supported here — with the parts, service and know-how to keep them running.

story.title: What we do
text: We sell, install and support the machines that metal fabricators, steel service centres, rebar shops, HVAC contractors and window manufacturers use every day: press brakes and panel benders, fiber lasers for sheet and tube, shears and ironworkers, band saws and cold saws, plate rollers and section benders, tube benders, deburring and finishing machines, rebar benders and cutters, aluminum and PVC window machinery, and press brake tooling.

Our customers range from one-person welding shops to production plants in the steel structure, automotive, aerospace, die and mold, medical and general part production industries — in every province and territory.

story.title: How we work
text: We start with your parts, not with a catalogue. Send us a drawing or a photo and tell us the material, thickness, length and volume, and we will recommend the machine and the options that fit the work — and tell you when a smaller machine will do the job.

Every machine we sell is fitted with a CSA-approved electrical panel for Canadian voltage and comes with a one-year warranty. Our technicians commission machines, train operators and troubleshoot by video call, and spare parts are stocked in Mississauga, ON, Canada.

story.title: Who we work with
text: We have built long partnerships with manufacturers on several continents: Dener, GMS, ISITAN, Bekamak, Plastmak and Tubend in Turkey; Gecam, Eurofintec and EUROSTAMP in Italy; Cevisa in Spain; Wecotech in Switzerland; WIKUS in Germany; CSM in Taiwan; and Senfeng in China. Our own NovoTech premium line is built in Turkey to our specification with European components, and the NovoTech value line is built to North American quality standards.

story.title: Our mission
text: To give every customer the right machine for the application at hand — and to stay with them after the sale, with the parts, service and advice that keep the machine making money for years.

quote.intro: Tell us about your shop and the parts you make, and we will recommend the machine that fits — with pricing, delivery and the right voltage option.
